SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT — v1.1 Owner: Lucas Buzek

ENGLISH

ARCHITECTURE APPLICATION → EDEN/DOMAIN API → PLATFORM CORE → PLATFORM
ADAPTER → DRIVER → HARDWARE.

REUSE BEFORE REBUILD Check EDEN Apps, WebApps/PWAs, native OS
capabilities, installed applications, external providers/services,
open-source components and existing project implementations. Integrate
through stable contracts, links, adapters, tabs, embedded views or
provider APIs. Rebuild only when functionality, reliability, offline
operation, privacy, safety, performance, licensing, platform support or
required integration justifies it.

EXECUTION TIERS 0 DETERMINISTIC / EXISTING 1 TINY SPECIALIST 2 LOCAL AI
3 LAN / SHARED AI 4 EXTERNAL AI/API 5 HYBRID Select the lowest
sufficient tier per capability.

MODEL SELECTION Do not standardize only by parameter count. Match
capability, hardware/resources, latency, context, language,
multimodality, tool use, structured output, privacy, license and
measured quality. A smaller specialist model may be preferable to a
larger general model.

DETERMINISTIC AUTHORITY Persistent state, transactions, hardware actions
and consequential operations use deterministic validated services
wherever practical. AI proposes/interprets/reasons; authoritative
services validate and execute.

PROVIDER ABSTRACTION Apps request capability contracts and declare
acceptable providers/fallbacks. A provider may be local, LAN, cloud/API,
native app, OS or deterministic library. Providers must be replaceable
without migrating the App’s authoritative identity.

FAILURE / FALLBACK Every AI-assisted capability defines behavior for:
model unavailable; API unavailable; Internet unavailable; insufficient
resources; privacy restriction; invalid output; timeout; low confidence.
Fallback may be deterministic, TINY, local, another provider, deferred
execution or explicit unavailable state. Never fabricate success.

INSTALLATION INSTALL/RECOMMENDED detects device/resources/native
capabilities/existing software. Reuse adequate software. Avoid duplicate
runtimes/models. LEAN installs core essentials. FULL installs all
appropriate supported capabilities. CUSTOM exposes choices. Heavy
optional models should be install-on-first-use where practical.

UPDATES CHECK → DOWNLOAD/STAGE → VERIFY → BACKUP → UPDATE →
TEST/REGRESSION → COMMIT. Preserve user data, downloads, models and
unchanged dependencies where valid. Do not redownload unchanged verified
components unnecessarily.

TESTING PASS / FAIL / UNKNOWN / SKIPPED / N/A. Generated ≠ tested.
Static checks ≠ compile. Compile ≠ runtime. Runtime ≠ hardware
verification. Record build ID, version, installation path/ID,
manifest/integrity and last-known-good.

LOCALIZATION One codebase. English reference/fallback. EN/SK baseline
for private/custom/ experimental distributions. Public releases are
multilingual-by-design through LINGUA.

OBSERVABILITY LCAS exposes truthful state/control/activity. It does not
invent progress. CONDUCTOR orchestrates; LCAS
observes/controls/statuses.

SLOVENSKY

ARCHITEKTÚRA APPLICATION → EDEN/DOMAIN API → PLATFORM CORE → PLATFORM
ADAPTER → DRIVER → HARDWARE.

NAJPRV ZNOVU POUŽIŤ Skontroluj EDEN App, WebApp/PWA, OS, nainštalované
aplikácie, providerov, open-source a existujúcu implementáciu. Integruj
cez stabilné kontrakty/adaptéry. Vytváraj nanovo len pri odôvodnení
funkčnosťou, spoľahlivosťou, offline, súkromím, bezpečnosťou, výkonom,
licenciou alebo platformou.

ÚROVNE VYKONANIA 0 DETERMINISTICKÉ / EXISTUJÚCE 1 TINY ŠPECIALISTA 2
LOKÁLNA AI 3 LAN / ZDIEĽANÁ AI 4 EXTERNÁ AI/API 5 HYBRID Vyber najnižšiu
postačujúcu úroveň.

VÝBER MODELU Nerozhoduj iba podľa počtu parametrov. Hodnoť schopnosť,
hardware, latenciu, kontext, jazyky, multimodalitu, tool-use, structured
output, súkromie, licenciu a nameranú kvalitu.

AUTORITA AI navrhuje/interpretuje/uvažuje; validované deterministické
služby vykonávajú autoritatívne zmeny a fyzické akcie, kde je to
praktické.

FALLBACK Každá AI schopnosť definuje správanie pri nedostupnom
modeli/API/internete, nedostatku zdrojov, privacy obmedzení, neplatnom
výstupe, timeout alebo nízkej dôvere. Nikdy nepredstieraj úspech.

INŠTALÁCIA RECOMMENDED je device-aware a znovu používa vhodné existujúce
komponenty. LEAN = minimum; FULL = vhodné všetko; CUSTOM = voľba. Ťažké
voliteľné modely inštaluj pri prvom použití, ak je to praktické.

AKTUALIZÁCIE A TESTY Zachovaj dáta, modely a nezmenené overené
závislosti. PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN/SKIPPED/N/A. UNKNOWN nie je PASS.

LOKALIZÁCIA A STAV Jeden codebase; EN referencia, EN/SK baseline,
verejné verzie cez LINGUA. LCAS ukazuje pravdivý stav; CONDUCTOR
orchestruje.
